importIntro.heading: 📥 AI chunked document parsing
importIntro.bodyPart1: Upload any document (lore compendium, finished novel, outline draft… even tens of millions of characters); the AI parses it in sequential chunks extracting
importIntro.bodyHighlight: worldview / characters / outline chapters / Codex entity candidates
importIntro.bodyPart2: . Before starting, choose whether to write into the
importIntro.bodyPart4: , while Codex entries become evidence-backed candidates for you to confirm afterwards.
importIntro.limitsHeading: Supported file formats and size limits
importIntro.chunkingNote: ⚠️ Large documents are automatically split by "chapter boundaries" or "paragraphs / characters", about {{chunkSize}} characters per block, processed serially by the AI.
importIntro.blobPersistNote: ✨ <1>The original text is automatically saved to the browser's local IndexedDB</1>; even if you close the browser, next time you can <3>resume with one click</3>, no re-upload needed.

reusableBanner.deepFallbackNotice: (the original text is no longer in memory; deep analysis will fall back to quick — re-upload if you need deep)

confirmModal.heading: About to start chunked document parsing
confirmModal.structureAutoCreateHint: Volume→chapter outline hierarchy will be created automatically during import
confirmModal.behaviorSerialBody: : each block calls the AI independently; the previous block's result is injected as "recognized context" for the next, keeping characters consistent.
confirmModal.behaviorRealtimeBody: : each successful block writes immediately to the worldview / characters / outline tables. Switch tabs or refresh and you'll see what has been parsed so far.
confirmModal.behaviorCodexBody: : Codex entities only become candidates backed by source quotes; after the task you pick, rename, or reclassify item-by-item — nothing enters the codex until confirmed.
confirmModal.behaviorRetryBody: : each failed block is retried up to 3 times automatically. Blocks that still fail can be retried individually at the end.
confirmModal.behaviorMergeBody: : every 10 blocks + a final pass, the AI looks for "same names/aliases" and merges duplicate records of the same character.
confirmModal.warningText: <1>Note</1>: you can switch tabs during parsing, but <1>do not close the browser</1> (closing loses the in-memory source text; resuming later requires re-uploading the same file).
confirmModal.targetDescription: After parsing, data will be written to:
confirmModal.targetProjectBody: Directly fills the current project's worldview, characters, outline, and other modules
confirmModal.targetReferenceBody: Saved to the "Project Reference" page as creative reference, without affecting the current project. <1>Includes a 13-dimension work analysis</1> — pick a depth:
confirmModal.refDepthDeepDesc: 300–500 characters per dimension + source quotes, detailed per-block reading
confirmModal.exampleIntro: Taking the "Opening techniques" dimension of "Battle Through the Heavens" as an example:
confirmModal.exampleShallowBody: : uses the "fallen genius" contrast hook; within three golden chapters completes the "broken engagement → discovers elder in ring → vows comeback" loop, piling frustration then immediately offering hope.
confirmModal.exampleDeepBody: : ① hook = sudden fall from a high point ("three levels of Dou power" nails the shame); ② emotional anchor = broken-engagement scene + signature line "Don't bully a poor youth"; ③ cheat denied first, granted at the most desperate moment; ④ oppression→release cycle every three chapters; ⑤ reusable patterns: falls must sting, anchors need memorable lines, don't hand out the cheat too early.
